definitions.world_angular_velocity_z: -dot(projected_gravity_b,root_angular_velocity_b); cross-checked against quaternion rotation to 1e-5 rad/s
definitions.world_heading: Unwrapped Euler yaw from root quaternion wxyz; its derivative differs from world angular velocity Z when tilted
definitions.reward: Reconstructed from telemetry: flat -5*(gx^2+gy^2), body -3*(gx^2+gy^2), gyro -.1*(wx^2+wy^2), yaw 4*exp(-(command_wz-world_wz)^2/.5^2). Weighted rates before dt; per-step includes dt=.02. Not total reward, AMP reward or causal reward attribution.
definitions.time: Post-step telemetry labelled step*.02; active command steps100-749.

limits: Only one seed/environment and 20 seconds each.
No pushes; other observation noise and randomization kept at current runtime settings.
Matched tests isolate checkpoint behavior under common evaluator settings; they do not identify which training change caused differences.
Prior generator-terrain vs plane comparison is not a pure terrain ablation: environment creation can alter seeded random draws.
Native history-encoder inference only. No foot-contact telemetry or velocity-estimator telemetry.
